# Doral Fashion Week (DFW)

> Official premier fashion, couture runway, talent showcase, and editorial magazine platform in Doral / Miami, Florida (part of the Idol Jose Group Corp ecosystem).

## Overview
- **Website:** https://www.doralfwmagazine.com/
- **Magazine:** https://www.doralfwmagazine.com/
- **Headquarters:** Doral Business Center, 4805 NW 79th Ave #3, Doral, FL 33166, United States
- **Official Email:** info@doralfwmagazine.com
- **VIP Concierge & WhatsApp Desk:** +1 786-647-5982

## Official Portals & Applications
- [Designers Runway Application](https://www.doralfwmagazine.com/apply/designer): International and emerging designers applying for Doral Fashion Week runway showcases and collections.
- [Models Casting Portal](https://www.doralfwmagazine.com/apply/model): Runway and editorial model intake with digital participation agreement.
- [Makeup Artists Portal](https://www.doralfwmagazine.com/apply/makeup): Backstage makeup and beauty artists registration.
- [Photographers & Media Portal](https://www.doralfwmagazine.com/apply/photographer): Runway, backstage, and editorial media accreditation.
- [Event Staff & Volunteers Portal](https://www.doralfwmagazine.com/apply/staff): Production, hospitality, and operations team intake.

## High-Ticket Partnerships & Sponsorships
- **Corporate & Luxury Brand Sponsorships:** Title Sponsor, Runway Gold, VIP Hospitality Lounge, and DFW Magazine brand placements.
- **International Designer Packages:** Full runway production, backstage MUA/hair team, casting models, and DFW Magazine coverage.
- **VIP Front Row & Buyer Passes:** Priority runway seating and exclusive media access.

## Related Holding & Partner Ecosystem
- [Idol Jose Official](https://idoljoseofficial.com/): Haute Couture Atelier & NYFW Runway Designer.
- [Idol Jose Group Corp](https://idoljosegroupcorp.com/): Luxury Fashion, Media, Runway & Business Holding.
- [Doral Business City](https://doralbusinesscity.com/): Executive Business, Leadership, Fashion & AI Magazine in South Florida.
- [Agencia Prosper IA](https://agenciaprosperia.com/): AI Concierge 24/7 & Digital Ecosystem Architecture.
